raw_record.question_text: Please choose the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows. <image_1>

method.method_draft: First describe the image structure without considering arrows: identify a five-membered heterocycle containing O-C-N-C-C connectivity, with the top ring carbon double-bonded to an exocyclic N-R3, the left ring carbon bonded to R and O−, the ring N bonded to R1, and the right ring carbon bonded to R2; a separate H+ is also shown. Convert each R group to '*' and traverse the molecule starting at R3 as */N=C1\OC(*)([O-])N(*)C1*, then append the disconnected proton as .[H+].
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中为一个五元杂环结构，环内包含一个氧原子和一个氮原子；顶部环碳与外侧的 N-R3 形成双键；左侧环碳连接 R 和带负电的 O−；环内氮原子连接 R1；右侧环碳连接 R2；旁边还有一个独立的 H+。题目要求忽略弯箭头。
推理：将 R、R1、R2、R3 都用通配原子 * 表示。从 R3 所在的外侧氮开始书写，得到 */N=C1\OC(*)([O-])N(*)C1*；再把图中独立的质子作为断开的组分 .[H+] 加到后面。因此 SMILES 为 */N=C1\OC(*)([O-])N(*)C1*.[H+]。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct graph-to-SMILES transcription from the displayed connectivity; no alternative inference route is needed because the task is essentially to encode one drawn structure.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the five-membered ring as C1-O-C-N-C1 with an O atom at upper left, an anionic oxygen substituent on the left ring carbon, an N bearing R1 in the ring, a carbon bearing R2, and an exocyclic imine N bearing R3 attached to the top ring carbon. Also note the separate proton H+ and ignore all curved arrows as instructed.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the required output is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure and that curved arrows in the image should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: replace unspecified R/R1/R2/R3 substituents by wildcard atoms '*', mark the deprotonated oxygen as [O-], include the separate proton as .[H+], use ring digit 1 for the five-membered ring closure, and preserve the drawn imine E/Z slash notation around N=C as / and \ as in the matching SMILES.
